summary: Command epic mechs and dominate the battlefield in this real-time strategy game.
description:
Welcome to MechCom 2 - the ultimate futuristic real-time strategy game that puts you in control of powerful mechs, ready to wage war and secure valuable resources on the planet Tiberius. With immersive graphics, intuitive controls, and engaging gameplay modes, MechCom 2 takes the genre to new heights.

In the XXII century, multinational corporations have risen to power, surpassing governments and venturing into space in search of precious resources. As a distinguished military commander, you'll join one of these corporations and lead your forces in a high-stakes battle for dominance.

Key Features:
• Command a variety of stylized 3D mechs, each with unique abilities, strengths, and customization options.
• Establish and expand your bases to gather resources and strengthen your military presence.
• Engage in an intense campaign on the planet Tiberius, fighting for control over rare minerals.
• Experience challenging AI opponents that will push your strategic skills to the limit.
• Unleash your tactical genius in different game modes, each offering thrilling and diverse gameplay challenges.
• Immerse yourself in stunning 3D graphics that bring the futuristic battlefield to life.
• Enjoy a smooth and intuitive control system, allowing for seamless gameplay on mobile devices.
• Play without interruption - MechCom 2 contains no ads or in-app purchases.

Prepare for an adrenaline-fueled adventure where your strategic decisions will shape the outcome of the conflict. Lead your mechs to victory, dominate the battlefield, and claim the rare resources for your corporation. MechCom 2 offers a fair and immersive gaming experience, free from ads and in-app purchases.

Good luck and have fun!
